description: How the customer roles of a travel organisation on the platform relate to each other: who sells to whom, who hands work to whom in operations, how money settles between travellers, operators, resellers and DMCs, and which information loops steer the business.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Selling, quoting and booking of travel products

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Day-to-day departure operations, supplier requests and service delivery

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Invoicing, payment collection, supplier settlement and commissions

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Proposals, documents, confirmations, feedback and management steering

relations.name: Books and pays
relations.description: Enquires by phone, email or the real-time website, accepts the quote or option and pays the deposit; the agent confirms the booking in the back office or the website does it straight through.

relations.name: Requests a tailor-made journey
relations.description: Shares travel wishes, dates and budget and iterates on the proposal until the itinerary and price fit.

relations.name: Sends visual proposal
relations.description: Publishes a day-by-day visual itinerary as an online quote the traveller can review, comment on and approve.

relations.name: Books operator products for clients
relations.description: Places bookings and options on the operator's products through the reseller portal, replacing phone calls to the reservations desk.

relations.name: Publishes availability, documents and changes
relations.description: Keeps real-time availability, travel documents and change notifications visible to the reseller so its clients stay informed.

relations.name: Hands over confirmed bookings
relations.description: Confirmed bookings, passenger details and wishes flow into departure operations without re-keying.

relations.name: Sends service requests and passenger and room data
relations.description: Requests ground services per departure and pushes every change to passenger lists and room lists one-to-one to the DMC.

relations.name: Confirms, rejects or counter-proposes
relations.description: Answers each service request in the supplier portal with a confirmation, rejection or alternative, so the operator knows which components are secured.

relations.name: Requests ad-hoc components
relations.description: Sends the individual accommodation, transfer and activity requests of a tailor-made trip file to the DMC and tracks which remain unconfirmed.

relations.name: Invoices ground services
relations.description: Invoices the operator for delivered ground services; the invoice is matched against the confirmed requests and settled through accounting.

relations.name: Invoices and collects
relations.description: Issues deposit and balance invoices with payment links and reminders and confirms received payments on the booking.

relations.name: Settles commissions and agent invoices
relations.description: Invoices reseller bookings net or gross and settles the agreed commission with the reseller.

relations.name: Steers on margin and cash
relations.description: Sets margin, receivables and close targets and reviews the finance dashboards that report against them.

relations.name: Sets capacity and yield policy
relations.description: Decides minimum participants, price tiers and merge or cancel rules that operations applies to every departure.

relations.name: Sets target margin and proposal standards
relations.description: Defines the target margin per trip file and the house style of proposals that specialists must sell within.

relations.name: Delivers seats, rooms, guides and documents
relations.description: Publishes seat and room assignments, guide details and travel documents to the traveller's my-trip portal and app before departure.

relations.name: Feeds back reviews and repeat bookings
relations.description: Surveys, Trustpilot reviews and repeat bookings signal brand health and feed the marketing segments the owner grows direct sales with.

relations.name: Reports closed books and filings
relations.description: Reports the closed month, guarantee-fund and package-travel filings and receivables status to the owner.
